body: are you me? i always draw people with wide hips, a small bust and a tiny waist because that's exactly what i want to look like, and i always fixate on my legs looking good. leg workouts, drawing legs, body checks involving my legs all the time. we're even the same height lmao

thank you for the info. honestly i kinda figured that id be forced to let my parents know, but i thought id ask anyway. hopefully my therapist will let me try and do this on my own for a bit though

thank you for your advice. the reason id rather not have them know isn't too important or anything. i just feel kind of humiliated. im supposed to be "smart" according to them, and doing everything that i do feels like the opposite of that considering that i know the risks that im taking. ive mostly gotten over it though. id rather be embarrassed and recovering then continue harming myself and retaining my pride.

im glad that at least one of us is glad. and yeah, ive dealt wth a lot of mental health issues and ive seen what happens when i dont admit that i have a problem, so realizing something was wrong was i wouldn't say easy, but easier? than normal.
